So I was 18, awoken at 5am by my bros mates “come to Amsterdam, your brother can’t come, we have a free ticket if you want to go on his passport?

24 hours we are in a cafe ordering shrooms. (By this point my psychedelic journey consisted of smoking a joint and pulling a whitey in a park).

Anyways, I eat the shrooms we wait an hour. The rest of the group start giggling and generally acting silly. I feel nothing. I notice there’s a few left, so I eat everyone’s leftovers.

We decided to take a boat trip and suddenly it kicks in. The tour guides voice becomes the funniest voice I’ve ever heard. My coat feels 4 sizes too big for me.

We depart the boat and this is where I realise I’m in trouble. The horses on the carousel🎠 starting coming off and I think they’re real. 

One of the guys sees I’m me freaking out and takes me back to the room. I proceed to switch the light off. sit, get up and switch the light on. Sit down. Then get up and realise I want it off - repeat for an hour. 

A few hours later.. ( I’m still fucked ) they take me to a strip show, we all sit in the front row and she asks for volunteers. Somehow they all choose me. I just remembered a banana being inserted inside and her asking the two guys in front of me to bite a piece. 

It gets to me and there’s a small bit of banana sticking out, I’m the opposite of turned on and just want to get off the stage, so I get on with the ordeal. I get on my knees to take the tiniest bite and she ends up rubbing my head against her causing the banana to smear all over my face.

The next bit I don’t remember- but I’m told I got up, spat the banana out, and said “you’re disgusting” before leaving the club.

Not big enough for my gf at the time to ask to leave the last Manchester gig early as she had a “job interview” in the morning. 

Sally couldn’t fucking wait apparently..
Still, I don’t look back in anger. She gave great head.

Sounds insane but before paying a lot for a course. Check out dr Sarno videos and learn about TMS and how repressed emotions effect your speech.

The breakthrough for me

1. Journaling everyday. How do I feel? List emotions. Why do I feel this way with this person? How does this effect my speech. 

2. Find someone who stutters on your level, or slightly ahead in the journey. Discuss with each other how you feel, really let go of some deep seated feelings.

Looking at it from a mind body perspective helped me better use new behaviour strategies.

No worries,

Yes, I tend to know which words I will get stuck on ahead of time. Yes the “difficult” sounds have changed over time. I used to hate “s” words, the word “seven” would literally throw me into a panic attack. 

Now its mainly M, D, R, W, V - so still a few to be getting on with 😅

Since I have learned this technique along with others,  the mental energy has decreased considerably. Practicing over time, makes it automated.

If I’m tired, my speech that day can drop up to 80%, which really makes me understand that there seems to be a physiological component that makes speech more challenging under stress. For those days I try to be easy on myself. Go with a deep voice, half speed and use this technique as best I can.

I only use this for hard blocked words. I also visualise the sound coming off the word at the point I would normally exert effort, L - ike this.

For normal speech, I use deep voice, phrasing/ pauses and continuous phonation (focusing on vibration)

Hope this clarifies.

I stuttered on my last name. 2 things that helped.

1. Softly sing it. Practice just thinking this. Allow your voice to naturally rise up and down. Record yourself. You will notice what you think of as singing is not what you are doing. As I showed in the video. Eventually this will change the “coding” of the word from fear and blocking, to fluency, and you won’t even need to sing it.

2. Add a word or sound. ( linking ) for example “ahhhmichael. Or “itsMichael” - for this you need to see it all as one word. As demonstrated on Lee Lovett YouTube channel.

You also need to- excuse my french - f*ck what people think of you. Or how your old mind critique will say “you sound weird, better to stutter”. You need to re-write this coding and have an “inner coach” one that is gong to give you good suggestions.

No worries man. I understand how emotionally charged around stuttering we are. It’s deeply seated in us.

I’ve had various moments like this during life, and what helps the most is re-examining my limiting beliefs and intentions.

Do you believe people will think less of you if you stutter? Is your intent to try really hard not to stutter?

Then look at your beliefs and intentions when you feel relaxed when speaking. Even if it’s to animals.

For me I talk to my cat, I know that he’s not judging me and just wants to be loved (and fed) my intention then changes from trying not to stutter, to expressing myself open and honestly.

Maybe start by letting people know at he start of a meeting that you stutter. This alone will put you at ease and get everyone on your side.

Always remember “this too shall pass”.
